question_text: How busy was the food court during lunch hours on average?
answer_text: On average, the food court had an 81.87 headcount during lunch hours.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z'
  AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  AND substring(ch.hour_utc, 11, 2) IN ['11','12','13']
  AND (
    toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'foodcourt' OR
    (toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'food' AND toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'court') OR
    toLower(l.name) CONTAINS 'foodcourt' OR
    (toLower(l.name) CONTAINS 'food' AND toLower(l.name) CONTAINS 'court')
  )
WITH sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS weighted_sum, sum(ch.event_count) AS total_samples
RETURN CASE WHEN total_samples > 0 THEN weighted_sum / total_samples ELSE 0 END AS avg_headcount
